verdict_meaning: One representative was selected from the two Gate 3 admitted candidates by a return-blind, parameter-free rule applied in full to both and recorded with its limitation; the seven frozen gate 4 conditions were extracted from frozen text, adopted by digest where they already existed and specified prospectively in the one place where they did not; and the whole procedure was sealed before any validation observation was read, which is measured rather than asserted. It is not a gate 4 pass, not a gate 4 evaluation, not a prediction that the representative will be admitted, and not an authorization for holdout access, stage 5, paper trading, shadow-live or live trading.

verdict_token_is_not_a_gate_4_token.why: PASS is one of the seven primary verdicts in constitution section 10. STAGE_4_VALIDATION_PREREGISTRATION_FROZEN is a design-session reason code following the precedent of STAGE_3_ATTEMPT_2_PREREGISTRATION_FROZEN. Emitting the gate's pass token would claim a gate this session did not evaluate, and emitting its fail token would record a rejection on evidence that does not exist. Both belong to the evaluation session and to no other, and the builder refuses to write a package whose verdict borrows either.

cumulative_experiment_count.rule: Any later statistical interpretation uses the cumulative count across all attempts and stages. This stage does not reset it, and two runs of one frozen parameterisation on a fresh window do not undo the multiplicity accumulated in development.

multiple_comparisons_disclosure: The representative was chosen from two development-admitted candidates, which were themselves chosen from a larger set across two Gate 3 attempts. A validation pass therefore carries the selection history of everything that came before it.

Gate 4 applies no multiplicity correction, and this protocol does not invent one. What it does instead is hold the validation exposure to the minimum the gate requires: one candidate, one parameterisation, two runs, one read.

A single out-of-sample window evaluated once is the strongest evidence this project's design can produce at this stage. It is still one window, three years long, of one instrument, over one macro regime. It is not a demonstration that an edge exists.

adaptation_disclosure.statement: This selection was made in a session that had lawful access to Gate 3 development evidence. It is an adaptive step, not an independent one.
adaptation_disclosure.what_is_independent: The rule's output. Given the predicate, the answer is a function of shutdown booleans recorded in a sealed evidence file, and no return enters it.
adaptation_disclosure.what_is_not_independent: The choice of predicate. It was chosen by a researcher who had read the development evidence, and a different return-blind predicate could in principle have selected differently.
how_it_is_mitigated: The predicate has no tunable parameter, so it cannot be nudged toward an outcome once chosen.
The full application is recorded for BOTH candidates, including every variant that did not trip, so a reader can verify the count rather than trust it.
The independent frozen-threshold checks are recorded, including the one that does not flatter the selected candidate.
The surviving candidate's narrowest margin is recorded rather than left to be discovered.
The rule's return-blindness is stated as a checkable property of the predicate, not as an assurance about the author's state of mind.
adaptation_disclosure.not_concealed: The representative keeps its Gate 3 identifier unchanged, so it is traceable to the evidence that admitted it and to the two-attempt search that produced it.

no_selection_in_this_stage.statement: The selection is already made and sealed. This stage's evaluation session selects nothing: it runs one candidate and reports one verdict.
no_selection_in_this_stage.consequence_of_a_fail: See no_retuning_rule and stage_5_remains_prohibited_conditions. A fail is recorded and the project stops at Gate 4. It does not fall back to C1.

conflicts_found: S4-CONFLICT-1: The frozen constitution's Markdown states SEVEN Gate 4 conditions and its JSON companion carries SIX thresholds. The condition present in the Markdown and absent from the JSON is the last one: 'no material rule, feature, universe, or parameter change is made in response to validation results.' The other six correspond one-to-one. Resolution: The Markdown is authoritative and is the more restrictive of the two, so all seven conditions are evaluated. This mirrors S4-CONFLICT-1's Gate 3 counterpart S3-CONFLICT-1, where the same discrepancy appeared with five JSON thresholds against seven Markdown conditions and was resolved the same way.

S4-CONFLICT-2: The constitution's JSON companion supplies fail_result for gate 4 but has NO pass_result key. Gate 3 had the same defect; gate 5 does not, and carries pass_result ELIGIBLE_FOR_PAPER_TRADING. Resolution: The pass token is derived by negation of the stated fail_result, following the derivation already sealed for Gate 3 in SE100-CFG-3002: fail STRATEGY_REJECTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT yielded pass STAGE_3_STRATEGY_ADMITTED_IN_DEVELOPMENT, so fail STRATEGY_REJECTED_IN_VALIDATION yields pass STAGE_4_STRATEGY_ADMITTED_IN_VALIDATION. Both tokens are fixed in verdict_token_derivation below, before any validation observation exists, so neither can be shaped by an outcome.

S4-CONFLICT-3: The Gate 4 drawdown ceiling and the section 5.1 research shutdown are the same number, 15%, measured against the running high-water mark of the same daily-closing equity series. Carried forward from S3-CONFLICT-3, where the same coincidence held at Gate 3. Resolution: The equivalence is adopted unchanged: S4-C3 is MET if and only if the research shutdown never fires during the validation run. A candidate that trips the shutdown has by construction breached S4-C3.

S4-CONFLICT-4: New, recorded by this stage. The constitution requires 'at least 70% of completed walk-forward test folds' but nowhere defines a fold: no fold count, no fold length, no train/test split, and no definition of 'completed' exists in governance/, config/, or any prior report. A repository-wide search for walk_forward, walk-forward and walkforward returns only restatements of the constitution's own sentence. Resolution: Constitution section 8 requires a signed specification created before execution containing the primary metric and all pass/fail gates. That is the authority under which the fold construction is fixed here, prospectively, rather than chosen at evaluation time. The construction is declared in walk_forward_fold_construction below and is derived only from the frozen partition boundaries in SE100-GOV-1005.

S4-CONFLICT-5: New, recorded by this stage. The constitution's phrase 'walk-forward' implies periodic re-estimation of parameters on a training segment preceding each test segment. Gate 4's own seventh condition forbids any parameter change in response to validation results, and section 11 makes such a change a material change that creates a new candidate restarting at Gate 3. Re-fitting during validation is therefore prohibited by the same gate that names walk-forward folds. Resolution: The gate text constrains only 'test folds'; it names no train fold and imposes no condition on one. With re-fitting prohibited, the walk-forward degenerates into a sequence of contiguous out-of-sample test folds evaluated under one frozen parameterisation. That is the reading adopted, and it is the more restrictive one: it gives the candidate no opportunity to adapt within the window.

rule.name: Declared-variant research-shutdown screen
rule.statement: Eliminate any Gate 3 admitted candidate for which ANY of its declared runs - the PRIMARY parameterisation, any of its four declared robustness neighbours, or its section 7 required stressed-cost run - tripped the section 5.1 research shutdown on development data. If exactly one candidate survives, it is the representative. If both survive or neither survives, the rule does not decide and the stage stops for human selection.
rule.output_is_binary_per_variant: Each declared run either tripped the shutdown or did not. The rule counts trips. It does not compare magnitudes, does not rank, and has no threshold of its own to choose.

evidence.stop_for_human_alternative_recorded: The stage would have stopped with a BLOCKED verdict and referred the selection to a human, rather than reaching for a second criterion. A tie-break invented after the first rule failed would be a retrospective rule wearing a prospective rule's clothes.
what_the_rule_is_not: It is not a ranking. It produces a survivor set, not an order. Had both candidates survived it would have decided nothing, and the stage would have stopped for human selection rather than reaching for a second criterion.
It is not a claim that C1 is a bad strategy. C1 satisfied every hard Gate 3 condition and remains a Gate 3 admitted candidate on the record. It is not carried to validation.
It is not a repair of C1. Repairing C1's cost sensitivity or its neighbour breach would be a parameter change creating a new candidate under section 11, and is explicitly not authorized.
It is not a rule about magnitudes. C1's breaching drawdowns and C2's largest non-breaching drawdown are recorded below for completeness, but the predicate uses neither.

Neither token is invented and neither is taken from an operating prompt.
tokens.conjunctive_note: Gates are conjunctive per constitution section 9: every hard condition must pass. At Gate 3 the stage verdict was additionally a disjunction ACROSS candidates, because Gate 3 asked whether a candidate worth carrying forward exists. Gate 4 has no disjunction: exactly one representative is evaluated, so conjunction within that candidate IS the stage verdict. There is no second candidate whose result could rescue it.
tokens.single_representative_note: Because exactly one candidate is evaluated, no admissible_candidate_exists disjunction row exists at Gate 4. The decisive row is the representative's own conjunction. This is a narrowing relative to Gate 3 and is deliberate: it is the consequence of the single-read rule, not a loosening of it.

narrowest_margin_of_the_survivor.why_it_is_recorded: The screen is binary and those variants did not trip, so the rule's output is unaffected. But a reader entitled to know how close the surviving candidate came should not have to derive it. C2 is the survivor of this screen; it is not a candidate with comfortable risk headroom.
narrowest_margin_of_the_survivor.consequence_for_gate_4: S4-C3's ceiling is the same 15% on the same series (S4-CONFLICT-3). A representative whose development neighbours sat 34 basis points from that level has no margin to spare on a fresh window, and the drawdown condition is a real risk of failure, not a formality. This is recorded before any validation observation exists.

cumulative_experiment_count.gate_3_attempt_1: 6 primary parameterisations, one per declared candidate family, as recorded in results.per_candidate_primary of reports/stage3/STAGE_3_STRATEGY_RESEARCH.json. That evidence file records no robustness-neighbour and no stressed-cost variant, because all six failed S3-C2 on the primary run.
cumulative_experiment_count.gate_3_attempt_2: 15 gating variants across three candidates - one primary and four declared robustness neighbours each - plus three non-gating stressed-cost runs, 18 development runs in total. Counted from results.all_registered_variants (15 keys) and results.stressed_cost_runs (3 keys) of reports/stage3_attempt2/STAGE_3_ATTEMPT_2_STRATEGY_RESEARCH.json, sha256 26eecacfe96420878ce647b86f68da8ed8a17fea1338d85ee982b190645ed466.
cumulative_experiment_count.rule: Any later statistical interpretation uses the cumulative count across all attempts and stages. This stage does not reset it, and two runs of one frozen parameterisation on a fresh window do not undo the multiplicity accumulated in development.

multiple_comparisons_disclosure: The representative was chosen from two development-admitted candidates, which were themselves chosen from a larger set across two Gate 3 attempts. A validation pass therefore carries the selection history of everything that came before it.

Gate 4 applies no multiplicity correction, and this protocol does not invent one. What it does instead is hold the validation exposure to the minimum the gate requires: one candidate, one parameterisation, two runs, one read.

A single out-of-sample window evaluated once is the strongest evidence this project's design can produce at this stage. It is still one window, three years long, of one instrument, over one macro regime. It is not a demonstration that an edge exists.
evidence.no_multiplicity_correction_is_applied: Gate 4 specifies none and this protocol invents none. The cumulative count is carried forward for any later statistical interpretation instead.

S4D-C8.required: Two runs declared with a hard limit, one parameterisation, zero re-runs; every condition assigned to a run or to S4-C7; failure, defect, and unusable-data outcomes pre-committed; no discretionary choice left to the evaluation session
S4D-C8.verdict_semantics: MET here is a statement about the seal, not about behaviour on the validation window. It means the condition for a legitimate pre-registration was recomputed from the written artifacts and holds. No S4D condition is evidence about gate 4.

no_neighbour_runs.reason: Gate 4 states no neighbour-stability condition. Gate 3's S3-C7 required four robustness neighbours per candidate; Gate 4 requires none. Declaring neighbour runs on the validation window would be four additional searches over a window that may be read once, and the results would gate nothing. Their absence is therefore not a gap in the evidence; adding them would be an unauthorised expansion of the search.
no_neighbour_runs.consequence_recorded: Gate 4 will produce no validation-window robustness evidence. That is a limitation of the gate as frozen, not of this protocol, and it travels with the result.

iteration_budget.note: There is no search at Gate 4. The budget is not a limit on exploration; it is the statement that no exploration is authorized.

conditions_assigned_elsewhere.S4-C7: Scored by recomputing the sealed digest set, not by a run.

pre_committed_outcomes.missing_or_invalid_data: The frozen Stage 1 data-readiness evidence and the sealed engine specification govern. A missing session, a stale mark, or a non-positive price is handled exactly as SE100-CFG-2002 specifies, with no stage-specific exception.
pre_committed_outcomes.post_seal_defect: If a defect is discovered in this protocol, in SE100-CFG-4002, or in SE100-CFG-4003 AFTER the seal but BEFORE any validation observation is read, the defect is recorded, this pre-registration is superseded by a new one with a new artifact id, and the supersession is recorded in the new runs/ record's notes. The sealed files are not edited in place.
pre_committed_outcomes.partial_or_failed_run: A run that crashes, is interrupted, or does not reach 2024-07-31 produces no valid evidence and is not scored. Its conditions are NOT_EVALUABLE, which per constitution section 9 is not a pass.
pre_committed_outcomes.no_retuning: No rule, feature, universe, parameter, cost assumption, risk setting, indicator definition, fold construction, threshold or measurement method may be changed in response to any validation result. This is S4-C7 and it is measured mechanically by digest recomputation, not asserted.
pre_committed_outcomes.fail_is_a_deliverable: A Gate 4 FAIL is a result and is kept on disk with the same rigour as a pass. It is not a reason to retune the representative, to substitute the other admitted Gate 3 candidate, to reopen Attempt 2, or to re-read the validation window. Constitution section 11 makes any such change a new candidate restarting at Gate 3.

evidence.no_discretion_left: One parameterisation, two runs, one session, zero re-runs, every condition assigned, every failure mode pre-committed. The evaluation session executes; it does not choose.

no_tree_digest_inside_a_covered_file.note: Every 64-hex string in every covered file is either the digest of a tracked file on disk or the content digest of a Gate 3 development run's trades or equity curve, held under a key named for what it is. None is a tree digest and none is the file's own. A bare count would prove nothing; the resolution is the check.

sealing_is_unrepeatable.consequence: Re-invoking the sealing program returns exit 2 because the record already exists. A pre-registration is sealed once; regenerating it would destroy its meaning.

evidence.folds_do_not_redefine_the_window: The twelve folds partition the validation window into consecutive three-month blocks anchored on its frozen start. They tile it exactly; they do not move either boundary and they are not a new window.
